prompt:
Incident Report: On 2024-10-12 at 09:14 UTC the primary database became unavailable. 
The outage lasted 2 hours and affected 1,200 users who could not log in or save work. 
Engineers investigated query latency spikes and discovered a misconfigured index introduced 
in the previous deploy. The misconfigured index caused lock contention on the users table. 
Traffic was rerouted to a replica while the team prepared a fix. The issue was resolved by 
rollback to the prior release at 11:14 UTC. No data loss was detected. A post-incident 
review was scheduled. Follow-up tasks include adding index validation to the deploy pipeline 
and improving alerting thresholds. Customer support handled 340 tickets during the event. 
The status page was updated throughout. Recovery time objective was met.

Summarize in at most 60 words. Include these facts: database outage, 2 hours, misconfigured index, 1,200 users, resolved by rollback.
